description: C2-A30 hand-computed one-week backtest. Rain exposure beta = -500.00 (bar-like, so the hedge buys YES); basis r2 = 1 and |beta_S| = 520 >= 500, so h = 1 and N = min(ceil(1 x 500), floor(500)) = 500. Every day of the week is hedged at a real YES price of 0.30 (previous-day candle). Fee = ceil_cent(0.07 x 500 x 0.30 x 0.70) = ceil_cent(7.35) = 7.35. Premium/day = 0.30 x 500 + 7.35 = 157.35. Rain (YES) on Tuesday and Thursday pays 500 each.
